dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are concentrated on the upper-mid dorsal region. These structures exhibit a high-contrast transition from a dark, thick perimeter to a lighter gray interior with jagged, non-uniform edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, light-gray pixel clusters observed across the lateral surface, particularly concentrated toward the posterior. These blobs are irregularly shaped and lack a defined internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triangular formation is visible on the mid-dorsal ridge connecting three prominent 'O' rings. A secondary linear alignment of four smaller high-intensity blobs is visible below this triangle, running parallel to the lateral midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct light-toned patch encompassing the circumorbital and muzzle regions, contrasting sharply with the darker crown area.
